name: What happens after the wind damage evaluation?

mainEntity.name: What happens after the wind damage evaluation?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the wind damage evaluation, our inspector will discuss their findings with you, outlining the extent of the damage and recommending necessary repairs or replacement options. We will provide a detailed report and, if applicable, guide you through the process of filing an insurance claim, sharing our findings directly with your adjuster. The next step typically involves providing you with a transparent quote for the recommended work based on our assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: After evaluation, we discuss findings, recommend repairs, and provide a detailed report. We can also assist with insurance claims and provide a quote for the work.
